description: Header file defining the template class StorageBlock<T> for managing disk cache storage blocks, including methods for loading, storing, copying, and managing data buffers.

classes.name: StorageBlock<T>
classes.description: Template class managing storage blocks in disk cache, with methods for data management, hashing, loading, and storing.
